description: Readable, editable views for CSV/TSV, JSON, JSONL, YAML, TOML, INI, .env, XML, logs and Parquet, plus a nicer Markdown preview. Lightweight; handles large files.
config.title: Data Viewer
config.openAsTextPatterns: Glob patterns of files that always open as plain text even though Data Viewer handles their extension (config files you usually edit as code). VS Code settings files always open as text.
config.table.maxEditableMB: Tables larger than this (MB) open read-only with streaming, so huge files stay fast.
config.table.delimiter: Delimiter for delimited text files. `auto` detects it from the file name and content.
config.table.wrapCells: Wrap long cell text instead of truncating it.
config.log.follow: Follow new lines appended to log files (like `tail -f`) while the log is visible.
config.tree.expandDepth: How many levels of the tree are expanded when a file opens.
config.markdown.enhance: Improve the built-in Markdown preview: typography, GitHub-style alerts, footnotes, task lists, table of contents, front-matter card, wide tables, code copy buttons and image zoom.
config.markdown.frontMatter: How YAML front matter at the top of a Markdown file is shown in the preview: a compact properties card, or hidden like the stock preview.
